title: Dispatch: 19.4.3 creature legendary budget, multi-save, riders (attempt 1)
description:
Implement eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3 exactly per its DESIGN field (L1 legendary budget, M1 multi-save, R1 riders, indep:006 narrowing, registry, evidence). Importer work: follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md (no hand edits; regenerate with npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 plus the default .generated run; npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack must exit 0; regenerate docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md} with npx tsx packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts if its test requires it). Before changing anything, grep packages/core/src for consumers of creature legendaryActions, saves, and effects; if a deterministic consumer exists, stop and report.
Diff records.json after regeneration: every changed record must be in the L1/M1/R1 populations by query; list each with before/after. Any other churn: stop and report. Verify every rider's dice/type and every save DC against the record text.
HARD STOP: If the failure map reveals a new root cause, requires a new parser or extractor strategy, or creates generated churn outside the direct consequences of the current minimal fix, stop and report instead of broadening the implementation. Do not add complexity solely to suppress source-confirmed incidental improvements caused by the correct fix.
REPORT (bd notes): consumers found, changed records with before/after, existing test changes with rationale (preserves/strengthens/replaces), commands and results.
notes:
STOPPED at the pre-change consumer gate (no code, data, or test changes; no commit). Base main 6413bcc7.

DETERMINISTIC CONSUMERS FOUND (hard stop per DESIGN premise 'no deterministic capability consumes creature legendary budgets, saves arrays, or riders' is FALSE):
1. packages/core/src/state/actionEconomy.ts legendaryProfileFor (~L486-530): reads legendaryActions.description via LEGENDARY_COUNT_RE for the per-round allowance (fallback 3) and entries[].mechanics.usage.legendaryActionCost for option costs; drives the legendary_action spend engine (~L1291-1308 name lookup and cost). This is the L1 budget consumer. A typed budget field would be a second source for the same value.
2. packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts entryLists (~L338): reads legendaryActions.entries for innate-spellcasting/usage collection.
3. packages/core/src/discovery/packet.ts projectionLimits (~L423-438): reads mechanics.saves and emits a success-branch projection-limit note; M1 (multi-save emission) changes its input population.
4. packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts: extraDamage validator (~L4216) and the recurringDamage validator; R1 would add extraDamage frequency/type and a new recurringHitPointLoss kind here.
5. packages/core/src/rules/srdAudit.ts ~L1132-1141: audit reads legendaryActions.description/entries.
Also orchestrator/contextAssembler.ts and protocol.ts mention legendary budget for display and spend prompts (downstream of actionEconomy).

No consumer reads a creature saves array outside packet.ts; no engine path executes extraDamage/recurringDamage from creature records (kindSchemas validates only), so R1 is the least consumer-coupled item.

NEXT: dispatcher must decide whether the L1 budget/M1 saves change is permitted given actionEconomy and packet.ts consumers (a budget-based consumer change or a design amendment), then re-dispatch. Snapshot counts in DESIGN not re-verified (stopped before regeneration). Not run: npm run verify:worktree (no changes), beads:sync (dispatch said no push).
COMPLETED (attempt 1, resumed after the consumer-gate stop per DESIGN AMENDMENT A1-A3). Commit 4182e013 on eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3.2 (base main 6413bcc7). No push, no PR.

CONSUMERS (pre-change grep, confirmed): actionEconomy.ts legendaryProfileFor + spendTurnResource legendary_action (A1, changed); usageCounters.ts entryLists (reads entries only, unaffected); discovery/packet.ts projectionLimits (M1, verified: no new success-branch note for Whirlwind, Wall of Ice, or Bite; the note regex does not match their prose and the wall carries a branch on every clause); kindSchemas (validators extended); srdAudit.ts (reads description/entries only, unaffected).

A1 BEHAVIOR CHANGE: legendary allowance now comes from the typed legendaryActions.budget, not the description regex with silent fallback 3. A block without a typed budget yields allowance 0 with budgetUntyped, and legendary_action spends throw 'no typed budget' (fail closed). Per-option cost default 1 unchanged. All 30 SRD legendary creatures print and type the budget, so their behavior is unchanged. New test: actionEconomy.test.ts 'refuses legendary spends when the record block has no typed budget'.

CHANGED RECORDS: 56 (no adds/removes; creatures only; stat-block untouched). Before/after per class:
- L1 budget/timing/regain/oneAtATime added (30): aboleth, adult-black/blue/brass/bronze/copper/gold/green/red/silver/white-dragon, ancient-black/blue/brass/bronze/copper/gold/green/red/silver/white-dragon, androsphinx, gynosphinx, kraken, lich, mummy-lord, solar, tarrasque, vampire, unicorn (unicorn also R1). Timing/regain/oneAtATime are printed in all 30, so all three are typed in each.
- M1 saves: air-elemental Whirlwind [strength 13 half] -> [strength 13 half, dexterity 13]; ice-devil Wall of Ice [dex 17 half] -> [dex 17 half, con 17 half]; purple-worm Bite [dex 19] -> [dex 19, con 21].
- R1 riders (22 entries, 22 creatures incl. unicorn; triggeredEffect replaced by extraDamage with the same verbatim trigger where Charge/azer had one): assassin Sneak Attack (+extraDamage 4d6 avg 14 once-per-turn, no type); azer Heated Weapons (1d6 fire avg 3, trigger replaced); boar, centaur, elk, giant-boar, giant-elk, giant-goat, giant-sea-horse, goat, minotaur, minotaur-skeleton, rhinoceros, unicorn, wereboar Charge (extraDamage with printed dice/type/avg; elk no type); erinyes Hellish Weapons (3d8 poison avg 13); hobgoblin Martial Advantage (2d6 avg 7 once-per-turn, no type); priest Divine Eminence (3d6 radiant avg 10); salamander Heated Weapons (1d6 fire avg 3); spy Sneak Attack (1/Turn) (2d6 avg 7 once-per-turn, no type); bearded-devil Glaive (recurringHitPointLoss 1d10 avg 5); horned-devil Tail (recurringHitPointLoss 3d6 avg 10).
- Surprise Attack average (incidental, source-printed, same kind): bugbear, doppelganger (+average 7 / 10).

DESIGN DEVIATIONS (for reviewer): (1) recurringHitPointLoss omits endsWhen: the source prints no end condition for the infernal wound. (2) Whirlwind's bare 'If the saving throw is successful ... half' sentence is attributed to the first (Strength) clause, not the adjacent Dexterity clause, preserving PR #567 and the census anchor; the Dex clause has no printed branch. (3) Trigger for non-Charge riders is the verbatim rider sentence, since no generic trigger clause exists. (4) Hit-point increase sentences ('increases by 5 (1d10)') are not modeled.

TEST CHANGES (rationale): halfDamageSuccessBranches 'typed-save' single-save invariant replaced by a stronger one for creatures (clause count from printed ability saves + a half branch present); spells keep single-save (replaced, not weakened). srdMembershipCorrections: Surprise Attack expectations gain printed average. findingRegistry: row-with-reasoning count 17 -> 21 plus creature-completeness in narrowed list (registry rows changed by design). emit.test: legendary expectation gains budget 3. New file creatureLegendaryBudgetSavesRiders.test.ts (9 tests) covers populations (a)-(c) and the exact regressions (aboleth budget, purple-worm Bite, hobgoblin Martial Advantage, horned-devil Tail, boar Charge).

REGISTRY: legendary-economy, multi-save-entries, creature-ongoing-riders stay accepted with repair reasoning; creature-completeness (indep:006) narrowed.

INVENTORY: docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md} regenerated (1876 -> 1879 rows).

COMMANDS: npm ci ok; baseline regen byte-identical to committed pack before changes; import:dnd5e-srd regen to canonical pack (x2, final after Surprise average); verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exit 0 (final, zero churn); vitest halfDamageSuccessBranches 4/4, creatureLegendaryBudgetSavesRiders 9/9, actionEconomy 57/57, findingRegistry+srdMembershipCorrections+emit 126/126; npm run typecheck exit 0; npm run verify:worktree exit 0 (345 files passed, 2 skipped; 6411 tests passed, 3 skipped; measure-run 82.6s).

NOT DONE / follow-ups: beads:sync not run (dispatch said no push). Parent eshyra-o9bd.19.4.3 left untouched as instructed.
